profile.headline: Data Engineer | Ex-Microsoft | MCS @ ASU

positions.title: NSF Data Science and Analytics (DSA) Researcher
positions.description: Researched and developed predictions models for residential solid waste generation in North Carolina counties based on population demographics.

company.name: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

positions.title: Code Camp Particpant
positions.description: One of the 20 women selected from 300+ applicants from across the U.S and Canada to participate in a five-day immersion program. Attended technical workshops, company visits, discussions with leaders at Square, and hack with other women. Developed a Andriod application that utilized the Square and Google Maps APIs

positions.title: Explorer
positions.description: As a Visual Studio PM & Software Developer, I researched and conducted studies on the difficulties that developers face when porting an application from different .NET frameworks. Then developed a standalone .NET Core Portability Analyzer user interface that helps non-VS users determine how compatible their applications is to .NET Core 3.0

positions.title: Undergraduate CS Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Instructed 2 labs a week for an introductory computer science course, graded assignments and exams, and offered 10 hours of tutoring each week.

company.name: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked with an internal engine for language translation that utilizes artificial technology. 
Built an image processing pipeline using Python that enhanced the optical character recognition capabilities for noisy documents.

educations.schoolName: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

honors.title: NACME Scholar
honors.description: Recipient of prestigious NACME scholarship an award given by a network of leading corporations to recognize excellence of under-represented minorities in engineering and computer science
honors.issuer: Issued by National Action Council for Minorities in Engineering · Sep 2020

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted with setup, registration and proctoring of the regional MathCounts Competition

organizations.name: Rewriting the Code
organizations.description: A program for college women pursuing a career in technology that offers a lot of opportunities . Such as, coaching, educational programming, industry exploration , networking, and participation in the community of women across the US

organizations.name: ACM (Association of Computing Machinery)
organizations.description:
Attended Python Workshops, Career Prep Boot Camps, and Company Information Sessions.
Create a strong platform for women in computer science. Encourage women to be bold, confident in this male-dominated field. Increase women engagement in the ACM chapter at NC A&T.
